name: Gasthof Geislerhof
beschreibung:
Located in the charming village of Bach within the Tyrolean Lech Nature Park, the traditional Geislerhof welcomes visitors with authentic local flavours and cosy guestrooms.

The celebrated Lechweg hiking trail, the Joechelspitze cable car, and winter ski tracks are just moments away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Geislerhof in Bach provides warm comfort and regional cuisine in the pristine Tyrolean Lechtal.
